findings: Meaningful gameplay and full hook visible immediately.
Large robot/platform footage dominates portrait frame without stretching.
Brief and code are labeled as original experiment materials, not a live third-party generator.
Four-coin/portal completion matches the actual asserted run; reveal badge appears at the end of the run.
Caption groups fit safe bounds and avoid the robot/portal in reviewed frames.
Final CTA contrast improved and rechecked after a targeted scene repair.
limitations: Gameplay capture uses software WebGL and 600×1000 source; not equivalent to a native 1080p GPU recording.
Source orientation shot contains code not intended to be read line by line on mobile.
Geometry checks cover text, not automatic semantic detection of all gameplay objects.
No perceptual audio approval or human-level voice-naturalness claim.
Representative frames and geometry checks do not evaluate every animation frame.
Local neural voice and original procedural soundtrack require human listening review.
No viewer analytics or guaranteed viral potential.
